statusDetail: Complete 58-check audit. The requested South African host redirected to the UK experience; findings describe the observed redirect destination and original-host chain.

page.framework: Next.js homepage plus separate sports/casino applications
page.notes: The requested .co.za host redirects through four hops to betway.com/en-gb/. Representative high-risk templates were audited without authentication or placing a wager.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared default and emulated dark screenshots and computed color-scheme.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark capture is visually unchanged and the DOM reports color-scheme: normal, so the site does not expose or adapt to the system scheme.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and queried document animations.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Four animations remained running under reduce, including a 12,000 ms hero progress animation.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-contrast and corroborated with Lighthouse contrast analysis.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found the Login and Sign up controls at 3.16:1 instead of 4.5:1; the contrast preference did not change their styling.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered CSS/DOM for View Transition use and observed route/state surfaces.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The probe found no view-transition usage; navigation and major state changes use abrupt replacement while only carousel chrome animates.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected authored rendered CSS and mobile long-task/scroll layout evidence.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No animation-timeline or custom scroll-animation implementation was present, and mobile layouts scroll natively without horizontal overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected carousel and sports controls in desktop/mobile screenshots and DOM.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Carousel paging and horizontally arranged category controls use native buttons/links and remain operable at mobile width; no custom pointer-only surface was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared navigation chrome on long homepage, sports and casino templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Persistent compact navigation remains visible on long sports/casino pages, and category state is visibly selected.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured the sports onboarding callout near its target at a viewport edge.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The offer callout remains attached to the offer control and inside the viewport without clipping.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed screenshots of the hero carousel, selected tabs and onboarding cue.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Active carousel dots, selected tabs and the sports onboarding callout provide visible state and attention cues.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured first-load states on homepage, sports and casino.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The sports path simultaneously dims the page for onboarding and covers the lower viewport with a cookie modal, leaving core betting content inaccessible on arrival.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected overlay semantics and Lighthouse accessibility output.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The hero is a custom role=dialog without an accessible name; no native dialog element is used, and Lighthouse flags aria-dialog-name.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared first viewports across representative templates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Stacked consent and onboarding chrome occupies or obscures most of the useful sports viewport before the user can inspect content.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured layout at 360x800 on homepage and sports.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both layout captures report scrollWidth=clientWidth=360 and horizontalOverflowPx=0.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared hero, navigation, consent and game-card components at desktop and mobile widths.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Components reflow from desktop rows to compact mobile navigation/cards without viewport overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Programmatically focused the first 25 controls and read computed focus styles; checked Lighthouse target size.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Several carousel/team controls did not accept focus or expose no visible outline, although Lighthouse target-size passed.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed first viewports and headings across home, sports, casino and safer-gambling surfaces.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The welcome offer, Register/Join actions, sports markets, casino games and safer-gambling tools each communicate a clear purpose and next action.

checkOutcomes.method: Navigated directly to the linked registration route and recorded final URL/content.
checkOutcomes.evidence: https://betway.com/gb/en/account/registration redirects to /gb/en/sports and renders no registration form, so the primary signup flow cannot start.

checkOutcomes.method: Opened a broken legal route and inspected its rendered recovery state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The error surface clearly says “Oops... page not found” and offers a return to the homepage.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse plus a DevTools trace and mobile layout observation.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 3.62 s and FCP 3.11 s (needs improvement), despite low CLS 0.011 and TBT 32.5 ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Observed layout shifts for five seconds on home and sports mobile.
checkOutcomes.evidence: CLS stayed low at 0.0118 on home and 0.0111 on sports with no horizontal overflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Read Lighthouse main-thread diagnostics and sports long-task observer output.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports 2.2 s main-thread work and 9.2 s time-to-interactive; sports recorded five long tasks up to 183 ms.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR, confirmed script defer/async attributes against DOM, and reviewed Lighthouse insights.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The original URL takes four redirects (estimated 2.09 s), with four render-blocking stylesheets and Lighthouse estimating 150 ms render-blocking savings.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse coverage diagnostics and reviewed HAR script weight.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 244 KiB unused JavaScript and 19 KiB unused CSS; GTM, gtag, OneTrust and FullStory dominate waste.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse accessibility checks and inspected rendered dialogs.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports an unnamed role=dialog; the probe confirms the promotional dialog has no aria-label or aria-labelledby.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse color-contrast audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Login and Sign up controls are 3.16:1 against the required 4.5:1 for their text size.

checkOutcomes.method: Focused interactive elements and inspected landmarks/headings.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage has no main landmark, two H1s and several controls that either fail focus or show no visible focus indicator.

checkOutcomes.method: Visually inspected desktop and mobile captures across content-rich and tool pages.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Body copy and primary headings remain readable without clipping on home, casino and safer-gambling mobile captures.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked viewport metadata, 360px reflow and Lighthouse target-size.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport zoom is not disabled, both measured mobile layouts reflow without overflow, and Lighthouse target-size passes.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse console-error audit.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse recorded no browser console errors during the audited load.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran doctype/charset and image audits.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype and charset pass, but all 12 inspected images omit width/height attributes, weakening intrinsic sizing guarantees.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran Lighthouse best-practices and inspected permission/auth API triggers.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission request-on-load or console error was found; document doctype and charset are valid.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered and raw metadata and ran Lighthouse SEO.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The final homepage has a descriptive title and meta description, both present in raw server HTML; Lighthouse passes both.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran discoverability and Lighthouse crawlability checks and measured mobile layouts.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Links are crawlable, viewport metadata is present, and 92% of rendered content words exist in raw HTML.

checkOutcomes.method: Fetched original-domain robots/sitemap paths and inspected final canonical/redirect chain.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The .co.za robots.txt and sitemap.xml requests redirect through the homepage chain to UK content; the final canonical is https://betway.com/en-gb/, not a South African locale.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage exposes zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph properties, despite public offer/content pages that would benefit from share previews and structured identity.

checkOutcomes.method: Audited final-document security headers and transport.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/frame denial are present, but X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are missing; CSP only defines frame-ancestors.

checkOutcomes.method: Captured HAR and tracker inventory before consent.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The load contacts 11 third-party origins, including Google Tag Manager and FullStory; 69 requests and 1.47 MB are classified third-party relative to the requested .co.za origin.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected permission triggers/WebAuthn use and attempted the public account registration route.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No permission prompt fires on load, but no WebAuthn/passkey signal is present and the registration route redirects to sports instead of an auth surface.

checkOutcomes.method: Audited CSP, HSTS, frame protection, referrer and permissions policies plus cookies.
checkOutcomes.evidence: HSTS and X-Frame-Options are set, but the CSP lacks script restrictions and the response omits Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and nosniff.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared raw no-JS HTML with rendered content and crawler screenshot.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page is server-rendered rather than a JS shell, with 92% raw/rendered word coverage and title/H1/description preserved.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed edge-positioned overlays, console errors and mobile states.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No console errors occurred, layouts avoid overflow, and the sports callout remains within the viewport.

checkOutcomes.method: Checked manifest and service-worker registrations.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A manifest exists but no service worker is registered. Transactional betting requires live odds/account state, so offline completion is not a safe or meaningful expectation.
checkOutcomes.reason: Transactional betting is intrinsically online; offline wagering would be unsafe and stale.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected the rendered not-found route and recovery action.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The not-found state clearly explains the failure and provides a route back to the homepage.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared requested host/locale with final URL and document language.
checkOutcomes.evidence: A South African .co.za request is redirected to en-GB content with html lang=en-gb, creating a locale mismatch for the requested market.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected locale, currency and final content after the geo redirect.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The .co.za request lands on UK offers and pound-denominated amounts rather than South African locale/currency content.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed sports event labels for explicit dates/times in the selected en-GB experience.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Sports listings consistently present explicit dated/time-labelled events in the active locale; no contradictory time-zone rendering was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed consent and safer-gambling first viewports.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Consent offers equally prominent Accept and Reject all controls, and safer-gambling controls are prominent and plainly labelled.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed the broken-route error state.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The 404-equivalent page uses plain language and offers a direct return to the homepage rather than blaming the user.

checkOutcomes.method: Attempted the registration path and inspected forms/autocomplete.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The registration URL redirects to sports and exposes no form fields, so expected signup/autofill assistance is unavailable.

checkOutcomes.method: Followed the homepage Terms & Conditions link and registration route.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The legal terms link renders “Oops... page not found” with an empty document title, while registration redirects to sports; key commercial/account assurances are inaccessible.

checkOutcomes.method: Ran image audit and reviewed transfer formats.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Seven of 12 inspected images use legacy formats and all 12 lack explicit dimensions, although responsive srcset is generally present.

checkOutcomes.method: Reviewed HAR, tracker inventory and Lighthouse unused-code estimates.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Analytics/consent/session-replay scripts load on arrival; Lighthouse estimates 244 KiB unused JS and the tracker inventory finds FullStory and Google tags.

checkOutcomes.method: Measured network transfer by party and largest resources.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page transfers 1.47 MB across 71 requests; 69 requests are third-party relative to .co.za, led by GTM, gtag, OneTrust and FullStory.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected scripts for WebMCP/tool registration and considered the wagering context.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No agent tool registration is exposed. Autonomous wagering is a sensitive high-risk action and no declared agent-facing intent exists.
checkOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing surface; autonomous gambling actions should not be inferred or exposed by default.

checkOutcomes.method: Inspected rendered scripts for built-in AI APIs and page purpose.
checkOutcomes.evidence: No on-device language-model or summarizer use is present, and the transactional gambling surfaces do not require local inference.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or local-inference use case is evident on the audited transactional surfaces.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared baseline and post heap summaries after ten carousel-next interactions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Heap self size rose only 180,286 bytes (1.1%) and nodes 2,444 (0.8%) across independent equivalent loads, with no Detached constructor in either summary.

checkOutcomes.method: Read heap summary totals and constructor distributions.
checkOutcomes.evidence: The homepage footprint is about 16.25 MB baseline and 16.43 MB post-interaction, proportionate to this media-rich page.

checkOutcomes.method: Compared top constructors before/after and searched summaries for Detached nodes.
checkOutcomes.evidence: Neither summary reports a Detached constructor and the small post-interaction growth does not indicate unbounded listener/DOM accumulation.

principleOutcomes.reason: No declared agent-facing surface; autonomous gambling actions should not be inferred or exposed by default. No summarisation or local-inference use case is evident on the audited transactional surfaces.

paths.description: Requested .co.za entry and redirected UK marketing homepage; tests global navigation, offer, consent, metadata and system preferences.
Sports listing and betting discovery template; tests dense interactive layout, navigation, onboarding and long tasks.
Casino listing/template representative of media-heavy game browsing.
Primary commercial signup journey reached from public Register/Sign up links.
Terms & Conditions legal route linked from the homepage.

findings.summary: South African domain redirects to UK locale
findings.evidence: A request for www.betway.co.za takes four redirects to https://betway.com/en-gb/, with lang=en-gb, pound offers and UK canonical; original robots/sitemap paths also resolve through that homepage chain.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the requested market or redirect to an explicit South African locale with matching lang, currency, canonical, robots and sitemap signals.

findings.summary: Registration route does not open registration
findings.evidence: The linked /gb/en/account/registration URL resolves to /gb/en/sports and renders no form.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore a stable registration route and a labelled, autofill-ready form; keep return/navigation state intact.

findings.summary: System color scheme is ignored
findings.evidence: Default and dark-emulated screenshots are unchanged and computed color-scheme is normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and map surfaces through prefers-color-scheme/light-dark() while preserving brand contrast.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference leaves long animations running
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, four animations remain active, including the 12-second hero progress animation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a reduce media query to stop autoplay/progress motion and replace transitions with instant state changes.

findings.summary: Primary account buttons fail text contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measures Login and Sign up at 3.16:1 against a required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the green or change foreground/background tokens so normal-size button text reaches at least 4.5:1.

findings.summary: Route and state changes lack View Transitions
findings.evidence: Rendered CSS/DOM has no view-transition usage while navigation/state replacement is abrupt.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-document or cross-document View Transitions for meaningful route/state continuity, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Stacked onboarding and consent overlays obscure the core sports task
findings.evidence: The first sports viewport is dimmed by onboarding while a cookie modal covers the bottom, leaving betting content inaccessible.
findings.suggestedFix: Sequence nonessential onboarding after consent and user intent; never stack modal layers, and preserve an immediate dismiss path.

findings.summary: Custom promotional dialog has no accessible name
findings.evidence: The DOM exposes role=dialog without aria-label/aria-labelledby and Lighthouse fails aria-dialog-name.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a native dialog/popover where appropriate and provide an accessible name linked to its visible heading.

findings.summary: Landmark and focus treatment is inconsistent
findings.evidence: The homepage has no main landmark; multiple carousel/team controls fail focus or show no visible outline in the focus probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a main landmark and consistent :focus-visible styling; ensure every interactive carousel control is keyboard-focusable.

findings.summary: Terms & Conditions link leads to a not-found page
findings.evidence: The homepage Terms & Conditions destination renders “Oops... page not found” and has an empty title.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore the legal document at the advertised URL, return a correct status/title/canonical, and monitor legal navigation links.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP needs improvement
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 3.11 s and LCP 3.62 s; CLS and TBT were good.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redirect latency and prioritize the actual LCP image/content while deferring noncritical analytics and styles.

findings.summary: Sports template produces long main-thread tasks
findings.evidence: The mobile sports observer recorded five long tasks, including 138 ms and 183 ms tasks; Lighthouse reports 2.2 s main-thread work.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile sports hydration/data processing and split or schedule work so tasks stay below 50 ms.

findings.summary: Redirect chain and blocking CSS delay delivery
findings.evidence: The entry URL takes four redirects; Lighthouse estimates 2.09 s redirect savings and 150 ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse redirects to one market-aware hop and inline/split critical CSS while loading noncritical styles later.

findings.summary: Large unused client payload ships on first load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 244 KiB unused JS and 19 KiB unused CSS, mainly analytics/consent/session replay.
findings.suggestedFix: Conditionally load third-party dependencies after consent/need and split page code by template.

findings.summary: Images omit intrinsic width and height
findings.evidence: The image audit found all 12 images without width/height attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio for every image while retaining responsive srcset.

findings.summary: Public homepage lacks structured/share metadata
findings.evidence: The rendered page has zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Organization/WebSite/Offer JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata matching visible content and locale.

findings.summary: Defensive response policy is incomplete
findings.evidence: Headers omit nosniff, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy; CSP only contains frame-ancestors.
findings.suggestedFix: Add nosniff, a strict referrer policy, least-privilege permissions policy, and a nonce/hash-based script/style CSP.

findings.summary: Tracking and third-party code loads before consent choice
findings.evidence: Initial load contacts 11 third-party origins including GTM and FullStory; 69 requests and 1.47 MB are third-party relative to .co.za.
findings.suggestedFix: Block nonessential analytics/session replay until explicit consent, minimize vendors, and enforce a measurable third-party byte/request budget.

findings.summary: Account surface exposes no modern authentication path
findings.evidence: No WebAuthn/passkey signal is present and the registration route returns sports content.
findings.suggestedFix: After restoring account routes, offer passkeys and request credentials only from explicit sign-in/register actions.

findings.summary: Image delivery still relies on legacy formats
findings.evidence: Seven of 12 inspected images are PNG/JPG-style legacy assets, though srcset is generally present.
findings.suggestedFix: Negotiate AVIF/WebP for photographic/decorative assets and preserve responsive source selection.
